_README: Hand-picked photographs, keyed by scientific name, valued by iNaturalist observation id. Photos are otherwise chosen by community votes, which reward a striking or curious picture rather than a legible one. Six of the eight best-voted Eastern Blue Groper shots are head-on portraits; five of eight Red Morwong; and the top-voted Australasian Snapper is a BLEACHED SKULL on a rock — a valid record, research grade, and no use whatever to someone trying to name a fish they just swam past. Prefer a side-on view of one whole living animal. Paste the observation id from the 'see the observation' link. Delete an entry to hand the choice back to the ranking.
